reden: Yes. The audit’s first High finding describes the same reentrancy via ERC721 _safeMint/onERC721Received where NextGenCore.mint/_mintProcessing updates tokensMintedPerAddress/Allowlist only after the external call. This allows reentering into MinterContract.mint to read stale counters, bypass per-wallet/allowlist limits, and mint out the collection. The functions, mechanism (CEI violation), attack path, and remediation (move state updates before external call) match the vulnerability description.
